label: Pre-encounter — news along the roads
location: The mountain realm, the north pass works

recentEvents.value: Word came along his own roads: ten realms broken into, their guardians' work smashed and pocketed as 'shards'.
He has doubled the inspection rounds on the aqueduct sluices and taught the valley crews the evacuation bells.

unresolvedConflicts.value: A stranger is using good roads to march on their builders. Ornig built those roads.

temporaryObjective.value: Check every span, brace every arch, and finish the north pass aqueduct before the road brings the hero to it.
